schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS person (person_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, person_name TEXT CHARACTER SET latin1, PRIMARY KEY (person_id)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attribute (attribute_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, attribute_type_id INT UNSIGNED, attribute_value INT, person_id INT UNSIGNED, PRIMARY KEY (attribute_id), KEY attribute_type_id (attribute_type_id), KEY attribute_value (attribute_value), KEY person_id (person_id)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
generation_sql: INSERT INTO person (person_id, person_name) SELECT n, CONCAT('Person_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count};
INSERT INTO attribute (attribute_id, attribute_type_id, attribute_value, person_id) SELECT n, MOD(n, 4) + 1, MOD(n, 10000), MOD(n, 10000000) + 1 FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count};

tables.name: attribute

calibration_queries.sql: SELECT person.person_id FROM person LEFT JOIN attribute location ON location.attribute_type_id = 1 AND location.person_id = person.person_id LEFT JOIN attribute gender ON gender.attribute_type_id = 2 AND gender.person_id = person.person_id LEFT JOIN attribute bornyear ON bornyear.attribute_type_id = 3 AND bornyear.person_id = person.person_id LEFT JOIN attribute eyecolor ON eyecolor.attribute_type_id = 4 AND eyecolor.person_id = person.person_id WHERE location.attribute_value BETWEEN 3000 AND 7000 AND gender.attribute_value = 1 AND bornyear.attribute_value BETWEEN 1980 AND 2000 AND eyecolor.attribute_value IN (2,3) LIMIT 100000;
